item.title: Forecast: Temperatures to drop slightly
item.description:
Today: Partly cloudy to cloudy. Temperatures will drop slightly and remain below seasonal averages across most of the country.
Light drizzle is possible along the coastal plain in the morning.
Tonight: Partly cloudy.

item.title: Jewish revival in Budapest: Synagogue reopens as a Jewish home run entirely by teenagers
item.description: Chabad emissary Rabbi Tzvi Bassman spoke to Arutz Sheva about the 150-year-old synagogue he heads, which has reopened to serve a community made up entirely of teenagers.

item.title: IDF salutes thousands of lone soldiers serving in combat roles
item.description: The IDF Personnel Directorate, FIDF, and Association for the Soldier honor 2,000 lone soldiers serving in combat roles, many of whom have no family in Israel. The average age of enlistment is 21.

item.title: Arad: Hundreds of Gerrer Hasidim mobilize after false report of draft evader’s arrest
item.description:
The “Tzeva Shachor" alert system sent voice messages to thousands of haredi residents in Arad overnight, warning that authorities were attempting to arrest a haredi draft evader in the city.
Hundreds of Gerrer Hasidim rushed to the scene in response, but it later emerged that no arrest attempt had taken place.

item.title: Rabbi Fendel: 'As rabbis, it is our duty to talk politics'
item.description: Rabbi David Fendel of Sderot Yeshiva defends rabbis’ involvement in politics, warned against voting for parties that may fail to cross the electoral threshold, and lamented divisions in Religious Zionism.

item.title: Palestinian report: IDF arrests senior Hamas official in Jenin
item.description:
Palestinian sources reported that IDF forces arrested senior Hamas official Abd al-Jarrar Jabbar at his home in Jenin early Monday morning.
According to the reports, Jabbar had previously been imprisoned in Israel and was released about two months ago.

item.title: Macklemore's UK tour to fund justifier of October 7 hostage-taking
item.description: Macklemore's upcoming London concert will raise funds for the Palestine Youth Movement, whose UK spokesperson defended Hamas's October 7 hostage-taking.

item.title: Newsom calls for conditions on US aid to Israel
item.description: California Governor Gavin Newsom calls for conditions on US military aid to Israel, criticizing Netanyahu for “isolating" Israel.

item.title: Zell on Trump's endorsement of Netanyahu: Political deadlock, repeated elections signal weakness
item.description:
Marc Zell, chairman of chairman of Republicans Overseas Israel, commented in an interview with Reshet Bet radio on US President Donald Trump's endorsement of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ahead of the upcoming elections.
Zell attributed Trump's support to the US administration's strategic considerations, saying: "Trump is looking at the interests of the United States regarding Iran and the entire region. Political deadlock and repeated elections send a message of weakness."

item.title: Watch: El-Sayed rejects Muslim Brotherhood, challenges questioner's motives
item.description: Michigan Democrat Abdul El-Sayed disavows the Muslim Brotherhood but challenges why he was asked, amid scrutiny of his positions on Israel and Hamas.
